direct_claims: This chart shows the share of each country's population living on less than $30 a day in 2025.
The subject belongs to the domain of global poverty and living standards measurement.
The chart states that the data are adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
The source is the World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform, and the chart is presented by Our World in Data.
The note indicates that the underlying measure may refer to either income after taxes and benefits or consumption per capita, depending on country and year.

Because the chart says values are expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices, the measure is intended to make purchasing power more comparable across countries than a simple market-exchange-rate dollar measure would be.
Some countries are marked as having no data.
